sections.title: MEANING IN CONTEXT
sections.instruction: Use the surrounding information to work out the meaning of the highlighted word.

sections.title: SYNONYMS AND ANTONYMS
sections.instruction: Choose the closest or opposite meaning, as requested.

sections.title: WORD FORMATION
sections.instruction: Choose the correct form of the word in brackets to complete each sentence.

sections.title: COLLOCATIONS AND PHRASAL VERBS
sections.instruction: Choose the word combination or phrasal verb that is natural in English.

sections.title: EXPRESSIONS AND COMMONLY CONFUSED WORDS
sections.instruction: Pay attention to the meaning and natural use of each expression or word.

questions.prompt: The proposal was rejected because its supporting evidence was tenuous and failed to convince the review panel. The word “tenuous” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “tenuous” berarti lemah atau tidak kuat. Petunjuknya adalah bukti tersebut gagal meyakinkan tim penilai.

questions.prompt: The committee's approval is provisional; it will become final only after the legal team has reviewed the documents. The word “provisional” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “provisional” berarti sementara dan belum final. Kalimat menjelaskan bahwa persetujuan baru menjadi final setelah dokumen diperiksa.

questions.prompt: The witness gave an unequivocal answer, leaving no doubt about what she had seen that evening. The word “unequivocal” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “unequivocal” berarti jelas dan tidak menimbulkan keraguan. Petunjuknya adalah bagian “leaving no doubt”, yang berarti tidak menyisakan keraguan.

questions.prompt: The new measures are intended to alleviate the pressure on families who have been affected by the rising cost of living. The word “alleviate” is closest in meaning to ....
questions.explanation:
Skill: Meaning in Context.

Penjelasan: “alleviate” berarti mengurangi atau meringankan. Kebijakan tersebut dibuat agar beban keluarga menjadi lebih ringan.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “pragmatic”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Synonym.

Penjelasan: “pragmatic” berarti praktis dan berfokus pada hal yang bisa dilakukan. “Practical” memiliki makna yang paling dekat.

questions.prompt: Which word is closest in meaning to “obsolete”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Synonym.

Penjelasan: “obsolete” berarti sudah kuno atau tidak digunakan lagi. “Outdated” juga berarti sudah ketinggalan zaman.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “ambiguous”?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Antonym.

Penjelasan: “ambiguous” berarti memiliki lebih dari satu kemungkinan arti atau tidak jelas. “Explicit” berarti jelas dan dinyatakan secara langsung.

questions.prompt: Which word is the opposite of “rigid” when describing a plan or approach?
questions.explanation:
Skill: Antonym.

Penjelasan: “rigid” berarti kaku dan sulit diubah, sedangkan “flexible” berarti lentur atau mudah disesuaikan.

questions.prompt: The report highlights the growing ______ of digital literacy in the modern workplace. (IMPORTANT)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Setelah “the growing” dibutuhkan noun (kata benda). “Importance” berarti kepentingan atau pentingnya sesuatu.

questions.prompt: Her argument was persuasive because it was supported by ______ evidence from several independent studies. (CONVINCE)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Kata tersebut menjelaskan “evidence”, sehingga dibutuhkan adjective (kata sifat). “Convincing evidence” berarti bukti yang meyakinkan.

questions.prompt: The unexpected ______ of the agreement surprised both negotiating teams. (WITHDRAW)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Setelah “the unexpected” dibutuhkan noun (kata benda). “Withdrawal” berarti penarikan atau pembatalan keikutsertaan dari suatu kesepakatan.

questions.prompt: The organization aims to distribute its resources more ______ among communities in need. (EQUITABLE)
questions.explanation:
Skill: Word Formation.

Penjelasan: Kata tersebut menjelaskan bagaimana sumber daya dibagikan, sehingga dibutuhkan adverb (kata keterangan). “Equitably” berarti secara adil.

questions.prompt: Before approving the proposal, the board must take the long-term consequences into ______.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Collocation.

Penjelasan: Ungkapan yang tepat adalah “take something into account”, yang berarti mempertimbangkan sesuatu sebelum mengambil keputusan.

questions.prompt: The findings of the latest survey are consistent ______ the results of previous research.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Collocation.

Penjelasan: Pasangan kata yang benar adalah “consistent with”, yang berarti sesuai atau sejalan dengan sesuatu.

questions.prompt: The audit turned ______ several discrepancies in the financial records that had not been noticed before.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Phrasal Verb.

Penjelasan: “turn up” dalam konteks ini berarti menemukan atau menunjukkan sesuatu yang sebelumnya tidak diketahui. Audit menemukan beberapa ketidaksesuaian dalam catatan keuangan.

questions.prompt: The sudden resignation of the director took everyone by ______.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Collocation.

Penjelasan: Ungkapan yang tepat adalah “take someone by surprise”, yang berarti membuat seseorang terkejut.

questions.prompt: The negotiations have not produced an agreement yet, and both sides appear unwilling to compromise. The talks have reached a deadlock. This means that ....
choices: they have reached a final agreement
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expression in Context.

Penjelasan: “deadlock” berarti keadaan buntu, saat tidak ada pihak yang bisa membuat kemajuan. Kalimat menunjukkan kedua pihak tidak mau berkompromi.

questions.prompt: The new policy may, to some extent, improve access to public services in remote areas. The phrase “to some extent” means ....
choices: partly or to a certain degree
questions.explanation:
Skill: Expression in Context.

Penjelasan: “to some extent” berarti sampai tingkat tertentu atau sebagian. Ungkapan ini tidak berarti perubahan terjadi sepenuhnya.

questions.prompt: The central ______ of the school's new policy is that every student should have equal access to learning opportunities.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Commonly Confused Words.

Penjelasan: “principle” berarti prinsip atau dasar pemikiran. “Principal” biasanya berarti kepala sekolah atau sesuatu yang utama, jadi tidak cocok dalam kalimat ini.

questions.prompt: The two departments have different responsibilities, but their roles ______ one another and help the organization work efficiently.
questions.explanation:
Skill: Commonly Confused Words.

Penjelasan: “complement” berarti melengkapi atau membuat sesuatu menjadi lebih baik. Peran kedua departemen berbeda, tetapi saling melengkapi. “Compliment” berarti memberi pujian.
